snippet.title: Sagas of Lumin - Riding Into A Dragon Ambush | Raw Gameplay
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130220/Sagas_of_Lumin/

Jump into the saddle for an intense aerial battle as one dragon rider confronts a menacing pack of enemy dragons. This video features the complete, uninterrupted gameplay sequence of the encounter, presented with no cuts. Witness the raw challenge and thrill of surviving this dogfight from beginning to end.
